full_text: Intro Encompass® System Administration Services We are Encompass® Certified Administrators Our Encompass® loan origination system administrators possess the skills necessary to maximize the potential of your mortgage business. We are here to help you adopt, innovate, and achieve digital transformation in the world of mortgages. Encompass is one of the best loan origination systems on the market, equipped with almost everything you need for your lending operation–we are here to fill in the available space in the above “almost.” With decade-long experience working with loan servicing softwares, our Encompass administrator can help enhance your system’s automation, manage processes and workload, and help improve system efficiency. Let’s Partner Up For Better Tomorrow… Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Encompass System Administration Services Our Encompass Administrative Support Services Manage User Accounts Find & Fix System Glitches Boost Operational Efficiency Conduct Risk Assessments Create Milestone Templates Add & Manage Business Rules Design Custom Input Forms Monitor System Usage Customize Workflows For your Encompass loan origination system, we provide the following support services so your business is always up and running without the slightest delay. We love seeing our customers happy and satisfied. Whether you’re a loan officer or a mortgage branch manager, we offer comprehensive assistance at every stage for a quick and smooth lending process. Our Encompass System Administration services extend to mortgage banks, credit unions, lending companies, and other financial institutions. Complete Solutions for your Encompass® Admin Needs by Certified Administrators Our dedicated Encompass Admins, certified by Ellie Mae (now a part of ICE Mortgage Technology), provide on-demand services for your needs. Each of our system admins is an integral part of our Support and Services team, which includes our other Encompass Mortgage Software Admins, Consultants, and Developers, so if any of our resources at your company are stuck with anything unusual, they have quick access to the answers and solutions from the mortgage tech experts. Our Admins can be your main Encompass administrator or provide backup support to your existing Encompass360 tech staff. This means you get professional guidance for your lending operations without dealing with recruitment processes, contracts, and onboarding expenses. ATI is here to fulfill your needs for reliable, top-notch, and result-oriented Encompass admin assistance at low costs. Encompass Administrator Service Packages We offer Encompass Admin Services with different packages designed to meet your unique requirements without the burden of hiring a full-time resource. Choose a system administrative plan that aligns with your business goals and enjoy efficient, cost-effective, and customized Encompass administrative solutions. 1. On-Demand Administration Support If your mortgage business requires a responsive solution, our on-demand Encompass admin support is a perfect choice. Access our administrative service whenever you have tasks that demand immediate attention, ensuring a quick and efficient response. 2. Hourly Admin Consultation Does your business need occasional assistance or have infrequent administrative tasks? Our Hourly Consultation package allows you to engage our Encompass administrator services on an as-needed basis. Pay only for the hours you use, providing you with cost-effective flexibility. 3. Admin on Contract Opting for our Encompass Admin on Contract package means you get dedicated administrative support over a specified duration. This commitment ensures a seamless integration of administrative functions into your workflow, allowing for sustained efficiency. 4. Monthly System Admin Ensure continuous and reliable Encompass360 administrative assistance with our Monthly Support package. It's a subscription-based model that provides consistent End-User support throughout the month, allowing you to focus on your core business operations.. 5. Virtual System Admin Services Embrace the future of remote support with our Virtual Encompass Assistant Services. Our certified Encompass developers and administrators will handle a range of tasks from a remote location, so there's no interruption in your office premises. 6. Project-Based Administration Encompass® Admin Services customized to your specific projects or initiatives. This flexible approach allows you to access our Encompass administrative assistance precisely when and where you need it, ensuring project success without needing a full-time admin resource. Our Ellie Mae-Certified Encompass Admins Execute the Following Tasks Reports Management Generate and manage general as well as custom reports tailored to different business groups. System Optimization Optimize the system through recommended enhancements. Customize Workflows Collaborate with guidance from mortgage department heads and translate their directives into Encompass® workflow. Automation Implement automation strategies, incorporating advanced business rules and ensuring the accuracy of existing rules. QA & UAT Supervise Quality Assurance (QA) & User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Encompass 360 Customization Tailor Encompass360 through customization, incorporating new business rules using plugins with Encompass SDK. Requirements Gathering Collect requirements from department managers, end users, and other stakeholders through information-gathering methods. System Design Solutions Devise specific designs and solutions for system workflows, pipeline views, input forms, reports, dashboards, and print forms. User Administration Administer company and user setups, roles, and personas. Third-Party Integrations Oversee and coordinate the integration of your Ellie Mae Encompass with tools through custom integration solutions. API/SDK Developer on Demand Provide services to convert SDK to next-gen API conversions and API integrations. Loan Setup Management Maintain updated loan setup settings in line with ongoing business needs. Documentation Collaborate with the marketing department to produce documentation for system updates and new features. Support Ticket Resolution Address and resolve support tickets promptly, establishing a connection with the tech team of ICE Mortgage Technology. Ensuring Compliance Monitor and ensure adherence to state and federal banking regulations and organizational policies and procedures. Our Comprehensive Encompass System Admin Support User Role & Access Controls We manage user roles, permissions and access controls to ensure that the right individuals can access the right areas of the system with minimal risk to security, and with the proper workflow controls, and audit ready. Plugin Monitoring & Updates We monitor all of your Encompass plugins to ensure continued compatibility with updates to the system and to install at a helpful time corresponding updates that may help provide your organization improved functionality. This allows for better use of the system reducing downtime and making users experiences across all integrations as seamlessly as possible. Loan Folder Automation Rules We set up automated loan folder rules to ensure documents land in organized folders for the status of the loan producing better data consistency and reducing manual work and touch points. This allows for more operational efficiency and productivity reducing the time your documents are open. Encompass Admin panel Our experts have access to configure your admin panel with your business process and compliance requirements in mind. We can set up your admin panel to reflect as close to the way your business runs as possible while ensuring users can easily navigate the admin panel, correct reports are being produced, and there is one location to control the system with respect to all settings. Workflow Optimization We will identify bottlenecks and adjust workflows to facilitate faster loans by reducing potential issues. Once optimization is completed, we can automate tasks to ensure actions are tracked and able to be adjusted at the organization level even if the workflow is not revised depending on the objective. Audit Logs & Reporting We can enable extensive audit trails and customize reporting dashboards to allow your team to not only have transparency and compliance, but also to report against performance and allow your team to have documents ready for audit outside your total loan document trail. We assist clients in optimizing and customizing Encompass® to fit their unique business processes, including operational goals and compliance requirements. We work with clients throughout the Lifecyle of the tool, from implementation and configuration to automation, reporting and integrating other third-party tools. Indeed, we use the Encompass SDK and APIs to develop our clients own solutions, supporting a more effective team environment and better user experience across teams. We offer our clients a proven record in delivering support for lenders, brokers, and investors so that they can maximize the full potential of Encompass®. Our consultants know the ins and outs of the newest enhancements, industry regulations, and best practices leveraged within the features of our clients’ integrations from the platform. Whether you are looking to optimize your current instance of Encompass®, or looking to introduce supportive systems or migrate to a new implementation of Encompass®, we provide hands-on system administrative services to help you optimize your operations with Encompass! How Do We Ensure Smooth LOS Performance? Step 1: Perform a Total System Health Assessment We start with a total system health assessment of your current Encompass® configuration, identifying existing performance bottlenecks, outdated plugins, security vulnerabilities, and compliance variances. This serves as a baseline for our improvements. Step 2: Optimize Roles and Access Settings We evaluate each user profile and permissions, to ensure that the access is appropriate, secured, and matching the team member’s requirements and responsibilities. This helps eliminate possible misuse and improves security and efficiency. Step 3: Redundant Workflows and Automation Rules We will identify and remove redundancies and will configure your automation logic such as task triggers, loan folder rules, and milestone notifications, so you may increase the amount of work done without requiring additional manual work, and process loans more rapidly. Step 4: Updating Encompass Plugins and System Components We will confirm all plugins, custom tools and integrations related to Encompass are current and fully supported by your system. This ensures your system remains responsive and avoids crashes due to incompatible or out of date components. Step 5: Implement Real-time Monitoring and Alerts We may employ systems monitoring tools to enable you to view all critical system metrics, error logs, and user activity in real time. Custom alerts allow administrators to be notified of critical system issues before they reach the point of negatively affecting your workflow. Step 6: Conduct Frequency of Compliance Reviews We keep ahead of regulatory changes by performing compliance audits periodically and adjusting and updating rules, fields, and documentation requirements, always so that your LOS is ready for an audit. Find answers to common questions about our Encompass® System Administration Services What are Encompass® System Administration Services? Encompass Systems Administration Services are managed support services designed to manage, support, and optimize the Encompass® loan origination system. These services ensure that the loan origination system is utilized properly, is functioning properly, is compliant, and is configured for the needs of mortgage lenders and mortgage brokers. What do the Encompass® System Administration Services include? Typical service delivery includes user setup and user access and permission administration, workflows and automation executions, templates and forms creation, maintaining and acquiring system updates, keeping the system compliant, reporting, and troubleshooting and optimizing the system after implementation. How much do Encompass® System Administration Services cost? Pricing will depend on various factors: level of service, level of service provider, outsourced service or in-house service. Pricing could either be hourly (typically $100-$200/hour) or periodic/monthly rates which can be flat fees (monthly) starting at around $2000 depending on the level of complexity and supply. How long do system administration services take to implement? Implementation timelines are dependent on scope of work, but initial setup and configuration usually take anywhere from a few days to several weeks. Ongoing administration is typically continuous, scaling based on needs of your organization. Do I need a full-time administrator, or can I hire as needed? You do not need a full-time administrator. Many organizations find outsourcing the Encompass® administration makes sense to manage overhead, bring anchored expertise, and allow scalability as needs change. Can the system be configured to our specific workflow? Yes, Encompass® can be configured. System Administrators can take the application and customize workflows, fields, business rules, automation logic, and templates so they match the organizations processes and comply with regulatory requirements. What about updates and compliance changes? System Administrators will typically monitor updates to the software and also news and announcements around compliance changes. They will stage the latest release versions in a testing environment before moving them to production, and they will tweak the configurations to ensure the system is operating effectively and legally. Is training included with System Administration Services? Training is commonly included or available as an optional add-on. Many service providers provide training specifically to assist administrators and end users so they understand new features, processes and updates as well as possible. Find answers to common questions about our Encompass® System Administration Services What are Encompass® System Administration Services? Encompass Systems Administration Services are managed support services designed to manage, support, and optimize the Encompass® loan origination system. These services ensure that the loan origination system is utilized properly, is functioning properly, is compliant, and is configured for the needs of mortgage lenders and mortgage brokers. What do the Encompass® System Administration Services include? Typical service delivery includes user setup and user access and permission administration, workflows and automation executions, templates and forms creation, maintaining and acquiring system updates, keeping the system compliant, reporting, and troubleshooting and optimizing the system after implementation. How much do Encompass® System Administration Services cost? Pricing will depend on various factors: level of service, level of service provider, outsourced service or in-house service. Pricing could either be hourly (typically $100-$200/hour) or periodic/monthly rates which can be flat fees (monthly) starting at around $2000 depending on the level of complexity and supply. How long do system administration services take to implement? Implementation timelines are dependent on scope of work, but initial setup and configuration usually take anywhere from a few days to several weeks. Ongoing administration is typically continuous, scaling based on needs of your organization. Do I need a full-time administrator, or can I hire as needed? You do not need a full-time administrator. Many organizations find outsourcing the Encompass® administration makes sense to manage overhead, bring anchored expertise, and allow scalability as needs change. Can the system be configured to our specific workflow? Yes, Encompass® can be configured. System Administrators can take the application and customize workflows, fields, business rules, automation logic, and templates so they match the organizations processes and comply with regulatory requirements. What about updates and compliance changes? System Administrators will typically monitor updates to the software and also news and announcements around compliance changes. They will stage the latest release versions in a testing environment before moving them to production, and they will tweak the configurations to ensure the system is operating effectively and legally. Is training included with System Administration Services? Training is commonly included or available as an optional add-on. Many service providers provide training specifically to assist administrators and end users so they understand new features, processes and updates as well as possible.
